name: agent-messaging

agentSupport.notes: Consumed as a sub-skill by council for inter-agent finding/alert exchange.

localChanges: Storage neutralised: replaced $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/agent-bus paths in send-message.sh, receive-messages.sh, and check-queue.sh with skill-local SCRIPT_DIR/messages, overridable via AGENT_BUS_DIR.

Kindling coupling generalised: dropped the .claude/hooks/kindling-capture.sh call and the `kindling query` read path; the file store is now canonical, with an optional AGENT_BUS_OBSERVER forward on send (non-blocking).
references/types.ts: removed @kindling/core / KindlingService docstrings in favour of neutral observation-store wording; modernised the substr() helper to substring().
SKILL.md authored born-neutral; Storage section documents AGENT_BUS_DIR and AGENT_BUS_OBSERVER.
Consumer call-sites in council updated from bare ./send-message.sh to agent-messaging/scripts/* paths.
Promoted inbox -> canonical and placed under eddacraft/ per the directory rule (orchestration infrastructure for the council review system).
Added portable payload-file input and a runtime-adapter boundary; bundled Bash and jq remain an explicitly POSIX-only fallback.
